phase: DEV-251 River Development Agent Controlled Executor Operation Execution Authorization Foundation
commitMessage: DEV-251: Build River Development Agent controlled executor operation execution authorization foundation
architectureStatus: Generation III controlled executor operation execution authorization foundation
predecessor: DEV-250 River Development Agent controlled executor operation preparation foundation
objective: Create a deterministic controlled executor operation execution-authorization foundation that consumes a trusted ready prepared DEV-250 operation-preparation record and derives an explicit fail-closed authorization decision governing whether that exact prepared operation is eligible to cross into a future controlled execution boundary, while preserving inherited capability authorization, authorization provenance, approved execution scope, preparation constraints, and strict separation between execution authorization and actual operation or repository execution.

Execution authorization requires approved execution scope evidence.
Execution authorization preserves the exact prepared operation.
Execution authorization preserves the required capability.
Execution authorization preserves authorized capability evidence.
Execution authorization preserves inherited approved execution scope.
Execution authorization preserves authorization provenance.
Execution authorization is deny-by-default.
Execution authorization is an authorization decision only.
Execution authorization cannot create capability authorization.
Execution authorization cannot expand approved execution scope.
Execution authorization cannot execute the prepared operation.
Execution authorization cannot modify repository state.
Execution authorization cannot delete repository state.

Execution authorization cannot push repository changes.
